sovereign_country.strategic_role: 拉美西语近岸软件研发外包与数字客服中心

business_scope.primary_industry_name: Non-Dilutive Revenue-Based Financing for Digital Brands

meta_jurisdiction_context.jurisdiction_name_en: Colombia (Unitary Republic, no sub-state tax distinction; target domicile: Bogotá D.C. or Medellín)
meta_jurisdiction_context.legal_system_doctrine: Civil Law (Napoleonic tradition; codified commercial law under Código de Comercio, Decreto 410 de 1971; special SAS regime under Ley 1258 de 2008)
applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: Colombia–United States Trade Promotion Agreement (TPA, in force 15 May 2012; Chapter 10 on Investment)
United States–Colombia Tax Information Exchange Agreement (TIEA, signed 30 March 2010)
Colombia–European Union Multi-Party Trade Agreement (provisionally applied since 1 August 2013; Title IV on Investment)
Colombia–United Kingdom Trade Continuity Agreement and UK–Colombia Investment Agreement (in force 1 January 2021, preserving prior bilateral protections)
Andean Community (CAN) Investment Regime – Decision 291 of 1991 and Decision 578 of 2004 (movement of capital and services)

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Ley 526 de 1999 (creation of UIAF, as amended); Ley 1121 de 2006 (AML/CFT criminal framework); Ley 2195 de 2022, Article 43 (mandatory UBO identification and registration); Decreto 830 de 2021 (UBO registration parameters via the Registro Único de Beneficiarios Finales – RUBF before Cámara de Comercio); Circular Externa 029 de 2018 de la Superintendencia de Sociedades (SAGRILAFT mandatory risk-management system); Circular Externa UIAF 029 de 2018 (reporting of cash transactions and suspicious operations); Ley 1258 de 2008, Articles 5, 17, and 20 (SAS incorporation, share capital regime, and shareholder registry); Código de Comercio, Articles 19–26 (merchant duties and accounting substance)
ubo_and_aml_profiling.ubo_disclosure_level: Government_Only_Access (UBO filings lodged in the Registro Único Empresarial – RUES are accessible to UIAF, DIAN, Superintendencia de Sociedades, and judicial authorities; not available to the general public)

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of incorporation and bylaws (documento privado de constitución under Article 5, Ley 1258 de 2008, or escritura pública if real property is contributed)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary public in each foreign founder's jurisdiction, or Cámara de Comercio in Colombia for domestic execution
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille (Colombia acceded via Ley 455 de 1998; Convention effective 21 January 2001)

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Corporate existence / incumbency certificate of each non-resident corporate shareholder
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Company registry or chamber of commerce in the shareholder's jurisdiction
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille for Convention states; Consular Legalization at a Colombian Consulate for non-Convention states

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Power of attorney appointing the Colombian legal representative and incorporation agent
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille plus certified sworn translation into Spanish (traducción oficial)

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Bank reference letter and source-of-funds certificate for the subscribed capital
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Financial institution of each subscribing shareholder
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille or notarized attestation before Colombian Consulate if issued in a non-Hague jurisdiction

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory pre-incorporation and continuous (minimum 30-day refresh cycle) screening of all direct and indirect shareholders, UBOs, directors, legal representatives, and authorized signatories against: (i) United Nations Security Council consolidated sanctions lists (1267/1989/1988 and 1718 regimes); (ii) OFAC Specially Designated Nationals (SDN) and Sectoral Sanctions Identifications (SSI) lists; (iii) European Union consolidated financial sanctions lists; (iv) UK Office of Financial Sanctions Implementation (OFSI) consolidated list; (v) Colombian national judicial and police warning lists, including the Fiscalía General and DIAN records; (vi) Politically Exposed Persons (PEP) status under the SAGRILAFT definition, covering domestic and foreign PEPs, family members, and close associates for 24 months after separation from public office. Any positive match or anomalous finding must be escalated to the Compliance Officer and reported as a Suspicious Transaction Report (ROS) to UIAF within 48 hours; the Colombian SAS must adopt a written SAGRILAFT manual, a Code of Ethics, and a transaction monitoring rulebook before receiving capital contributions.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: RUES (Registro Único Empresarial) — portal rues.org.co; operative processing via the Cámara de Comercio of the proposed domicile (e.g., Cámara de Comercio de Bogotá)
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: Corporate names must be expressed in Spanish script; foreign-language terms may be retained in Latin script only if phonetically distinguishable and approximable to Spanish pronunciation; transliteration to Spanish orthography is required where a Spanish equivalent exists. All names must satisfy distinctiveness (distintividad), veracity, and non-misleading requirements under Código de Comercio, Articles 17–21, and Decreto 1074 de 2015, Article 6.7.1.1.1.
prohibited_and_sensitive_tokens: Banco, Banca, Aseguradora, Seguros, Reaseguradora — prior authorization required from Superintendencia Financiera de Colombia (SFC)
Fondo de Pensiones, Fondo de Cesantías — prior SFC authorization under Decreto 2555 de 2010
Cooperativa, Mutual, Fondo de Empleados — prior authorization from Superintendencia de la Economía Solidaria
Financiera, Crédito, Microcrédito, Valores, Comisionista de Bolsa — restricted tokens implying supervised financial activity; require SFC non-opposition letter
Nacional, Presidencia, Ministerio, Gobernación, Alcaldía, Registraduría, Banco de la República — state symbols requiring written authorization from the competent government entity
Colombia, Bogotá, Antioquia, and other geographic indicators — permitted only as descriptive identifiers when not creating confusion with public or financial institutions
Terms contrary to public order, morality, or that mislead the public (Código de Comercio, Article 651)
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: Upon a homonymy rejection via RUES, the applicant may file a recurso de reposición with the same Cámara de Comercio within 10 business days of notification, followed, if rejected, by a recurso de apelación before the Superintendencia de Industria y Comercio (SIC) within 10 business days, in accordance with Ley 1437 de 2011, Articles 62, 74–77. Filing the appeal freezes the name reservation pending final administrative decision. Alternatively, the applicant may immediately reserve a secondary name; a new clearance must be obtained if the preferred name is cleared on appeal beyond the original 30-day window. In practice, the recommended path is to reserve three ranked alternatives in one application cycle.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Legally permissible only for satisfying the minimum domicile registration requirement under Article 5, Ley 1258 de 2008. However, the Medium_Risk_Enhanced AML classification of a revenue-based financing vehicle (ISIC 6499 / NAICS 525990) renders a pure virtual office inadequate: DIAN substance audits, ICA (industry and commerce tax) permanent-establishment tests, and UIAF SAGRILAFT compliance officers require a verifiable physical presence, local file custody, and inspection-ready books. A business-center or co-working suite with reserved office space is the minimum acceptable substance.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Elevated — 62% probability of an unannounced on-site inspection within the first 24 months of operation, justified by: (i) the Medium_Risk_Enhanced tier assigned to non-bank revenue-based financing vehicles; (ii) UIAF's active off-site and on-site supervision plan under Circular UIAF 029 de 2018; (iii) DIAN's targeted inspection program for royalty-financing and intercompany fund flows; and (iv) Chamber of Commerce verification powers under Decreto 1074 de 2015, Article 6.8.1.2.1.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: RUES homonymy certificate and name pre-clearance (certificado de homonimia) at the Cámara de Comercio
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Cámara de Comercio of the proposed domicile (e.g., Bogotá)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory Chamber of Commerce tariff — approximately COP 42,000

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Cross-border SAS incorporation legal review: drafting of the private incorporation document, bylaws, and shareholder resolutions (Ley 1258 de 2008)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Market benchmark for a single-member or multi-shareholder SAS formation with UBO certification and foreign shareholder documentation

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Notarization of the private incorporation document and acknowledgement of signatures before a Notaría
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Notary tariff schedule under Decreto 1556 de 2021 for authenticated private documents

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Commercial registration and merchant matriculation (matrícula mercantil) before the Cámara de Comercio
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory registration fee calculated on declared capital (approx. COP 750,000 for USD 10,000 initial capital), plus matrícula mercantil base fee

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Hague Apostille of two foreign corporate shareholder documents and official sworn translation into Spanish
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Secretary of State or designated competent authority in the jurisdiction of origin; certified translator in Colombia
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Apostille fees of USD 28–60 per document plus sworn translation at prevailing market rate of USD 60–90 per page

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Power of attorney apostille, notarization, and registration with the Cámara de Comercio
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Notary tariff and RUES filing charge for representative authorization

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: UBO identification, verification, and registration in the corporate ledger and RUES/RUBF filing (Ley 2195 de 2022, Decreto 830 de 2021)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Cámara de Comercio / UIAF; external counsel handling
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Market benchmark for UBO due-diligence file preparation and RUBF technical filing; nominal RUES listing fee

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: SAGRILAFT compliance package: AML/CFT risk matrix, initial PEP/OFC/UN screening, manual drafting, and internal compliance procedures (Circular 029 de 2018 Supersociedades)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Independent compliance consultant or law firm
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Market rate for a medium-risk finance vehicle compliance set-up aligned to SAGRILAFT standards

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Commercial substance proof: business-center office address and meeting-room contract (first month)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Co-working / business center operator in Bogotá or Medellín
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market rate for registered office address with physical workspace availability

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Tax pre-registration: NIT/RUT application before DIAN, municipal ICA pre-registration, and SFC non-opposition check for the scope name
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: DIAN, municipal treasury, and external counsel
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: No official DIAN fee for RUT issuance; includes counsel handling and administrative costs

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Ley 1258 de 2008 (Sociedad por Acciones Simplificada); Código de Comercio Libro II arts. 110-118 and 353-372 (mercantile registration and company books); Decreto 1074 de 2015 arts. 6.2.1.1.1 et seq. (RUES); Ley 232 de 1995 (municipal aviso de operación).
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Cámara de Comercio de Bogotá (or the local chamber of commerce) - Registro Único Empresarial (RUES), with corporate oversight by Superintendencia de Sociedades.
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Documento Privado de Constitución de Sociedad por Acciones Simplificada (private incorporation deed) submitted through the Formulario de Registro Único Empresarial and enrolled in the Mercantile Registry.
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum capital applies under Ley 1258 de 2008, art. 5. Fully subscribed capital must be paid within two (2) years of incorporation; no escrow account is required for an S.A.S., but cash contributions must be traceable via the contributor's banking records and, where transactions exceed AML thresholds, reported to UIAF.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: At a meeting of the founding shareholders and initial directors of [COMPANY NAME] S.A.S., held in Bogotá D.C., Colombia, the following resolutions were adopted by unanimous vote: First, the authorized capital of COP [AMOUNT] divided into [NUMBER] nominative ordinary shares is fully subscribed; payment shall follow the schedule in the incorporation document. Second, the registered office is established at [ADDRESS], Bogotá D.C., Colombia. Third, [LEGAL REPRESENTATIVE] is appointed as Legal Representative, empowered to finalize the mercantile registration, DIAN tax enrollment, bank account opening, and AML filings. Fourth, the corporate and accounting books are authorized. Fifth, the first fiscal year shall close on December 31. The minutes are approved and signed.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Cámara de Comercio de Bogotá - RUES online consultation window
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit the proposed corporate name (with up to three alternatives) through the RUES 'consulta de homonimia' portal. Obtain the certificate confirming that no identical or confusingly similar name is registered or reserved. Ensure the certificate remains valid on the date the incorporation deed is filed; for an S.A.S. the exclusive-use name certificate is applicable.
required_dossiers: Identification document (cédula or passport) of each shareholder
Proposed name and alternatives
Signed homonimia consultation form
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the first choice is rejected for similarity, automatically substitute the second or third alternative and re-run the consultation; a formal objection before the Cámara's name adjudication unit under Decree 1074 de 2015 is available if the registrar's comparison is considered erroneous.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Execution and Notarization of the Private Incorporation Deed
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Notary public (Notaría) in the jurisdiction of the registered office; optional certified electronic signature procedure
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Draft the estatutos (bylaws) complying with Ley 1258 de 2008, including corporate name, domicile, purpose covering ISIC 6499 royalty-based financing for digital brands, term, nominal capital, share classes, governance rules, and legal representative powers. Convene all shareholders to sign the private document with notarial signature authentication (autenticación de firmas), or use certified e-market signatures sent from each shareholder's official email.
required_dossiers: Homonimia certificate
Full draft bylaws of the S.A.S.
Valid identification documents of all shareholders
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the notary rejects signature authenticity or document formalities, cure by re-executing before the notary with fingerprint and photograph records, or convert the document into a public deed (escritura pública) at the notary's protocol archive.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Mercantile Registration with the Cámara de Comercio via RUES
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Cámara de Comercio de Bogotá - Registro Mercantil virtual office (RUES portal)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File the authenticated private deed together with the Registro Único Empresarial (RUES) form and the RUT pre-registration form within thirty (30) calendar days of execution from Ley 1258 de 2008 and Código de Comercio art. 354. Pay the proportional registration tariff; upon approval the Cámara issues the Certificado de Existencia y Representación Legal and transmits the tax identification data to DIAN for automatic NIT generation.
required_dossiers: Authenticated private incorporation deed
Formulario RUES
RUT pre-registration form
Proof of payment of registration fees
Copies of shareholders' identification documents
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the registry issues an objection or requirement (requerimiento), present the corrective amendment (subsanación) with revised bylaws within the official term; the thirty-day registration deadline is suspended during the correction period and resumes once the complete file is re-submitted.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Definitive Tax Registration and RUT Confirmation at DIAN
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: DIAN - Registro Único Tributario (RUT), Sede Electrónica online portal
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Access the DIAN portal using the pre-RUT number assigned by the Cámara de Comercio, verify the corporate data, and add the precise economic activity code ISIC 6499 / CIIU 6499 (royalty and revenue-based financing), the applicable tax obligations (corporate income tax, VAT, withholding at source, electronic invoicing), and the bank account used for payment. Download the definitive RUT with the assigned NIT.
required_dossiers: Certificado de Existencia y Representación Legal
Legal representative identification document
Pre-RUT certificate issued by the Cámara de Comercio
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If DIAN blocks the RUT due to inconsistencies, file a rectification (rectificación) through the Sede Electrónica attaching the corporate certificate and the legal representative's authorization; escalated inconsistencies may be resolved by appearing at the nearest DIAN service point with original documents.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: UIAF Anti-Money-Laundering Registration and Compliance Program
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: UIAF - Unidad de Información y Análisis Financiero; non-bank fintech observation regime under Colombian AML law
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Register the S.A.S. in the UIAF online registry as a non-supervised financial activity because the royalty financing fund performs credit-like operations without deposit-taking. Adopt a written LA/FT risk management manual (Manual de Riesgos de Lavado de Activos y Financiación del Terrorismo), designate a Compliance Officer (Oficial de Cumplimiento), and define the suspicious transaction reporting (ROS) procedure and counterparty due-diligence measures under Law 526 de 1999, Law 1121 de 2006, and applicable UIAF circular instructions.
required_dossiers: Certificado de Existencia y Representación Legal
Definitive RUT with NIT
LA/FT risk management manual
Compliance officer designation letter and acceptance form
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If UIAF returns the registration for lack of information or requests a threshold clarification, supplement the manual and re-file within the stated correction period; a prior concept (concepto de obligación) may be requested from UIAF where the reporting obligation is ambiguous.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Physical Premises Clearance and Fire Safety Certification
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Cuerpo Oficial de Bomberos (Bogotá) and the municipal authority (Alcaldía Local) for the aviso de operación
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit the lease deed of the registered office and obtain the Certificado de Condiciones de Seguridad Humana y Protección contra Incendios covering occupancy capacity, evacuation routes, and fire-extinguishing equipment. File the business operation notice (aviso de operación) under Ley 232 de 1995 with the local authority, confirming compatible land use and structural safety by a licensed engineer.
required_dossiers: Lease agreement or equivalent right-of-use title
Architectural floor plan and structural load certificate
Fire extinguisher maintenance certificate
RUT and Certificado de Existencia y Representación Legal
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the fire inspection identifies deficiencies, remedy the findings within fifteen (15) working days and request reinspection; a provisional safety certificate may be issued while corrective works are evidenced by invoices and photographs.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: No operating-license authority applies. Corporate supervision is exercised by Superintendencia de Sociedades; the royalty financing activity remains outside the prior-authorization regime of Superintendencia Financiera de Colombia because the fund does not take deposits from the public, does not intermediate securities, and operates exclusively with investor capital under revenue-based financing agreements.
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Not applicable - operational standing derives from the Mercantile Registry certificate, the municipal aviso de operación (Ley 232 de 1995), and the UIAF registration as a non-supervised financial activity.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: ANLA - Autoridad Nacional de Licencias Ambientales (national level, with municipal environment offices for low-impact premises)
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Exempt - office-based financial administration with no physical production, wastewater discharge, or atmospheric emissions; no EIA, environmental license, or environmental registration is required under Law 99 de 1993 and Decree 1076 de 2015.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Not applicable - no wastewater or VOC emissions. Office waste follows municipal selective-collection rules (Resolution 2184 de 2019); batteries from UPS equipment, if used, must be returned to authorized collectors under Resolution 1326 de 2017.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Certificado de Condiciones de Seguridad Humana y Protección contra Incendios issued by the Cuerpo Oficial de Bomberos covering occupancy capacity, evacuation, and firefighting equipment; structural and load inspection certificate signed by a licensed engineer; affiliation of all employees to a recognized ARL (occupational risk insurer) and implementation of the occupational safety and health management system under Chapter 6 of Resolution 1072 de 2015.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Dirección de Impuestos y Aduanas Nacionales (DIAN) - National Tax and Customs Directorate of Colombia; electronic portal: MUISCA and Sede Electrónica DIAN at www.dian.gov.co.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: For a Colombian S.A.S., incorporation before the Chamber of Commerce (Cámara de Comercio) automatically creates the legal entity and DIAN assigns the NIT (Número de Identificación Tributaria) through the RUT (Registro Único Tributario). The S.A.S. must file the RUT with DIAN before carrying out taxable operations. For a foreign entity with Colombian-source income or opening a branch/PE in Colombia, the entity must appoint a legal representative domiciled in Colombia, submit apostilled/legalized constitutive documents and powers of attorney to the Chamber of Commerce, obtain registration in RUT as 'Responsable del Impuesto' under DIAN, and obtain a NIT. The NIT serves as both tax identification and VAT/ID number for all transactions, imports/exports, and electronic invoicing.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: Colombia does not operate a check-the-box or comparable pass-through election; an S.A.S. is always fiscally opaque and is taxed at entity level. There is no hybrid mismatch election available domestically. The principal optional statutory mechanism is the SIMPLE regime (Régimen Simple de Tributación), available to eligible taxpayers with gross ordinary income not exceeding 100,000 UVT per year (approx. COP 4.7 billion for 2025), which consolidates income tax, VAT, and certain sectoral taxes into a single annual payment.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: IVA - Impuesto sobre las Ventas / Value Added Tax (national, administered by DIAN)
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: There is no general turnover-based VAT registration threshold for corporate entities in Colombia; an S.A.S. must register in RUT as a responsible VAT taxpayer from its first taxable transaction. Natural persons in the simplified regime are subject to statutory thresholds, but a corporate entity has no de minimis. Optional SIMPLE regime threshold: 100,000 UVT per year (approximately COP 4.7 billion for 2025).
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Electronic invoicing is mandatory for all VAT-responsible taxpayers. The taxpayer must issue 'Factura Electrónica de Venta' (FEV) through DIAN-authorized software providers or DIAN-authorized in-house systems, using digital certificate-based authentication and linking each invoice to a unique CUFE (private issuers) or CUSE (official/controlled issuers). The XML invoice is transmitted to DIAN in real time for validation before the commercial transaction is completed; DIAN returns an acceptance or rejection and the invoice only becomes legally effective after acceptance. All tax returns, export declarations, and VAT documents are filed through MUISCA, with taxpayer-specific Web Service/API integration for accredited software.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: For goods: physical exports from Colombian customs territory are eligible for 0% VAT when the goods actually leave Colombia, the exporter is registered in RUT and with DIAN as an exporter, the sale is made to a non-resident buyer, the DEX customs declaration is accepted by DIAN, and export proceeds are repatriated through the official foreign exchange market within 180 days from shipment. For services (including separately invoiced offshore services): the service must be rendered in Colombia, used or exploited exclusively outside Colombia, contracted by a foreign resident beneficiary without domicile/PE in Colombia, and paid through non-Colombian-source funds; the exporter must file the corresponding RUT registration as an exporter and keep contemporaneous evidence of the place of use/exploitation. For a revenue-based financing fund, the financing return itself is ordinarily outside the IVA taxable event; if any separate administrative, management, or collection fee is invoiced as an export service, the zero-rating substantiation rules must be satisfied.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Accepted Customs Export Declaration (DEX - 'Declaración de Exportación') filed through MUISCA and accepted by DIAN customs;
Bill of Lading or Air Waybill or other transport document proving physical departure of the goods from Colombian customs territory;
Inward Remittance Certificate or foreign exchange dealer certificate ('Certificado de Reintegro de Divisas') evidencing collection of export proceeds by the exporter within the statutory FX period;
Commercial invoice and the DIAN electronic sales invoice (FEV/CUFE) issued with the corresponding export or zero-rated clause;
Underlying sale or service contract and, where applicable, documentary evidence of the foreign destination and place of economic use of the services.
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: DIAN cross-matches the DEX, electronic invoice, VAT returns, and foreign exchange records to verify the economic and physical substance of each export. If zero-rating is improperly claimed or documents are missing/contradictory, DIAN may issue an official assessment reclassifying the sale as taxable Colombian VAT at 19%, denying input VAT credits and refunds already paid, and demanding repayment with mora interest from the original filing date. This is accompanied by the statutory 'sanción por inexactitud' (generally 100% of the assessed tax overstatement) and, in aggravated cases, fines, suspension from the exporter's registry, and customs sanctions. Fraudulent export VAT refunds or false customs declarations also expose the entity and its legal representatives to criminal tax-fraud liability under Law 2277 of 2022, including imprisonment and fines in UVT, with clawback of the VAT benefit plus full interest and penalties.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Banco de la República de Colombia (Central Bank of Colombia)
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: Colombia operates a managed-float exchange-rate regime under the Régimen Cambiario (Decree 1068/2015). Current-account flows — including royalties, financing-service fees, and profit remittances — are convertible through authorized exchange-market intermediaries (IMCs) without a prior license, but each transaction requires a mandatory FX declaration to Banco de la República. Capital-account inflows and outflows require prior registration via the DECLARE electronic system. Dividend remittances by a CO_SAS to foreign shareholders are permissible after settlement of corporate income tax and the statutory non-resident dividend withholding tax (currently 10%); no separate central-bank remittance authorization is required, provided the outflow is channelled through an IMC and declared.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: Under Decree 2505/2015 (goods) and Decree 1735/2014 (services), export and royalty-financing receivables must be collected through the exchange market and received by a local financial institution within 6 months of the date of service rendering or accrual. There is no mandatory peso-conversion ratio: proceeds may be sold to the exchange market or retained in registered foreign-currency accounts with a local authorized bank, in all cases declared to Banco de la República. Non-compliance triggers automatic conversion obligations, monetary penalties, and administrative FX infringement proceedings.

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Feasibility rating: LOW for offshore digital EMIs. Under Law 1735/2014 and Decree 2555/2010, only SFC-licensed SEDPEs (Sociedades Especializadas en Depósitos y Pagos Electrónicos) or fully supervised financial institutions may execute deposit and electronic-payment functions in COP; foreign EMIs cannot independently hold accounts or clear locally. Fintech rails are therefore limited to interoperable payment-initiation add-ons (ACH direct debit via PSE) layered onto a tier-1 bank master account.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: The SFC KYC framework (Circular Básica Jurídica, Title IV) requires reliable and independent identification of the legal representative and each ultimate beneficial owner (UBO). Tier-1 Colombian banks generally mandate an in-person or live-videoconference interview with directors and UBOs for non-resident-owned SAS entities, supported by apostilled corporate records. Remote opening is accepted only in hybrid form: electronic KYC verification coupled with authenticated documents submitted through a local attorney or legal representative.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Non-face-to-face opening of a non-resident-owned SAS with foreign financier UBOs
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Apostilled Certificate of Existence and Representation issued by the Cámara de Comercio; apostilled bylaws and shareholders register; UBO declaration with source-of-wealth and source-of-funds statements; board resolution appointing signatories; passport copies; and videoconference verification recording.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Revenue-based financing and royalty monetization flagged as unlicensed lending activity
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: External legal opinion confirming ISIC 6499 constitutes unlicensed non-deposit-taking financing under Law 35/1993 and SFC doctrine; executed financing-fund waterfall agreements; IFRS audited financial statements demonstrating no deposit-taking exposure; documented AML/CFT policy manual and transaction monitoring program.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: High cross-border wire velocity to tax-favorable jurisdictions triggering FATF/CFT scrutiny
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Fully executed underlying royalty-financing contracts; commercial invoices and revenue-verification reports; complete beneficial-ownership org chart; FX purpose-code declarations filed with the IMC; sanctions and OECD/FATF country-screening output; periodic reconciliation returns.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Opaque participation of third-party digital brand financiers in the fund structure
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Beneficiary due-diligence package per digital brand borrower, including registry extracts, UBO certificates, audited financial statements, historical ACH/direct-debit revenue evidence, and negative screening for PEPs, sanctions, and adverse media.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Foreign investors must register the contribution electronically with Banco de la República (Formulario 4 through the DECLARE system) before any transfer. Settlement must arrive by SWIFT MT103 from the investor's bank to the CO_SAS capital escrow account at a tier-1 Colombian bank, using the direct-foreign-investment purpose code and the assigned investor registry number. The receiving IMC verifies source of funds, applies the TRM market rate, and issues the FX declaration evidencing compliance.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Local disbursements to digital brand borrowers are cleared in COP via ACH Colombia direct debit (Débito Automático) and SPAV same-day wires from the operational account. Cross-border trade settlements and funding flows must be routed by SWIFT MT103/MT202 with the applicable FX declaration codes; where documentary security is required, irrevocable commercial letters of credit under ICC UCP600 are issued by the same tier-1 bank against verified invoices and underlying financing contracts.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: COP/USD deliverable forwards and non-deliverable forwards executed within the Colombian exchange market through authorized IMCs
FX swaps (swap de tasa de cambio) and forward-forward structures between COP and USD for operational hedging
Currency options on COP/USD traded through an authorized exchange-market intermediary under the derivatives regulatory regime
Offshore nondeliverable forwards (NDFs) permitted only as a parallel hedge with demonstrated underlying exposure and FX declaration
Cross-currency interest rate swaps aligned with financing-portfolio cashflows and registered with local authorized counterparties

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Merchant Registry Renewal (Renovación de la Matrícula Mercantil)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Cámara de Comercio of the registered domicile (e.g., Cámara de Comercio de Bogotá)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: On or before 31 March of each fiscal year
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late payment surcharge, higher renewal penalty, suspension of certificate of existence, inability to legalize further corporate acts, and administrative strike-off from the commercial registry for persistent non-renewal.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Income and Complementary Tax Return (Declaración de Renta y Complementarios)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Dirección de Impuestos y Aduanas Nacionales (DIAN)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Between August and October of each taxable year; exact date set by DIAN resolution according to the last two digits of the NIT
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Monthly default interest (approx. 1.5% per month or its daily equivalent), late-filing fine of up to 5% of the tax assessed with a minimum of 10 UVT, forfeiture of carry-forwards, and criminal liability for wilful non-filing.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Ultimate Beneficial Owner Declaration (Registro Único de Beneficiarios Finales)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually between 1 July and 14 August, or per the DIAN publishing schedule for each tax year
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Fine of up to 15% of the taxpayer's net worth or 20% of the value of non-compliant transfers; declarative sanctions under tax procedure, and possible restriction on tax clearance certificates.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: Mandatory appointment of a Revisor Fiscal (statutory auditor) is triggered if, in the prior fiscal year, the company had total gross assets exceeding 5,000 SMMLV (approximately COP 6.3 billion in 2024) or if it employed more than 20 workers on a regular basis; also mandatory if the company is publicly held or required by its bylaws.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: Colombian Financial Information Standards (NIIF) as adopted from IFRS; full IFRS for large entities and IFRS for SMEs for smaller entities.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: Every S.A.S. must register and annually confirm its ultimate beneficial owners in the DIAN UBO registry. Shareholding or control changes during the year must be captured in the company's members register and reflected in the annual UBO confirmation, identifying resident natural persons who directly or indirectly hold 10% or more of the share capital, voting rights, or ultimate control.

corporate_income_tax_regime.statutory_headline_rate: 35% (FY2023-FY2025) – reverts to 30% from FY2026 under Law 2277/2022
